context: Hiroshi-boss and Yuki prepare a board meeting.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: corporate governance; org vocabulary (会長/理事/職員/事務所/法人) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来週、理事会を開くことになった。
lines.en: We'll hold a board meeting next week.
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 会長も、出席されますか?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、会長と理事が全員集まる。
lines.en: Yes, the chairman and all directors gather.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 会場は、本部の事務所でしょうか?
lines.en: Is the venue the head office?
lines.style: thoughtful office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うむ、事務所の大会議室で行う。
lines.en: Yes, we'll hold it in the office's large room.
lines.style: clear boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 職員の出席は、必要ですか?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 担当の職員だけ、同席してもらう。
lines.en: Only the responsible staff will sit in.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 法人としての方針も、決まりますね。
lines.en: The corporation's policy will be decided too.
lines.style: understanding office woman voice, soft warm clarity closing throughout
